model.training_regime: common48: at most48 cells per training donor/context/condition stratum
model.estimator: Fit PCA on equal-donor context-condition effect profiles; ridge on context and condition/unit-dose indicators; alpha100, rank128. Intercept unpenalized.
model.selected_primary: Frozen O-selected completed328 Parse common48 primary panel

features.normalization: Full40352-source-axis library sum, CP10K float64, natural log1p, select fitted2000-axis, float32. Fixed training-derived positive scoring scales.

fixture.selection: First24 controls and first8 treated ordered by SHA256(fixed salt + source cell identifier), within one declared original training donor and context; selected without expression or score inspection.
fixture.purpose: Usage demonstration on previously used data, not independent validation or a performance claim

source.dataset: Parse Biosciences 10 million human PBMC cytokine dataset
